contentPattern: Two rows: row 1 = background image (optional; omit for solid/gradient color heroes), row 2 = rich text with optional eyebrow paragraph before the heading, a heading, body paragraph(s) and an optional CTA link paragraph. The image is rendered as a full-cover background with the text overlaid bottom-left. With description-box, body paragraphs after the heading move into a separate box.
usage: Page-top banner with a full-width background photo and overlaid white heading and copy. Default puts the text in a translucent panel on the left; Full Bleed overlays text bottom-left directly on the photo; Description Box splits the copy into a separate box at the bottom-right; Light and Purple are solid or gradient color heroes (event and campaign pages) with eyebrow, heading and copy; Shadow Light overlays an eyebrow and large heading on a darkened photo; Alt is a rounded card hero with heading and a CTA button.
reuseGuidance: Use for the first, full-width banner of a page when text overlays an image or a solid color band. Pick the option by text treatment (panel, plain overlay, split description box, color background, card). Use columns-media instead when image and text sit side by side.
